integrity: The proof was reconstructed from generator identities, conditional expectation, invariant-support tangency, and bounded completeness. The 2014 and 2025 same-system full texts were inspected directly, while incomplete-access sources are explicitly marked as residual risks. The packaged checker replays the exact algebraic identities and equilibrium relations used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes positive alpha, beta, kappa, and lambda; degenerate or sign-indefinite cases are outside scope.
It gives necessary stationary laws and equality rigidity, not existence or uniqueness of a chaotic invariant measure.
The complete 2022 article was not fully inspected through the available source path; its abstract and indexed material were compared.
Short average identities could exist in older electromechanical literature under alternative notation.
The nonzero equilibrium coordinates and their existence condition are prior structural information and are not claimed as new.
title: Exact stationary current–speed disintegration and equilibrium-speed defect in the Hide–Skeldon–Acheson dynamo
